summary: Global currency markets are currently reacting to a firming U.S. dollar, supported by safe-haven flows as artificial intelligence jitters weigh on risk sentiment. Meanwhile, the euro and British pound are facing downward pressure ahead of upcoming central bank decisions and domestic fiscal updates. Traders are closely monitoring Treasury yields and broader risk-off dynamics as major central bank meetings approach.

outlook.reason: The euro slips as a rebounding dollar and AI-driven risk aversion weigh on the common currency.
The pound faces downward pressure as a firm dollar and broader risk-off selling weigh on currencies.
The pair is expected to remain range-bound amid upcoming central bank decisions and conflicting safe-haven flows.
Declining Treasury yields and broader market uncertainty are fueling a haven bid that supports gold.
